messages.contentHtml:
I made three key responsive fixes so the form stays usable on small screens:

  1. Layout: Changed the main page grid to flex flex-col on mobile, so the form and output panel stack naturally with full page scrolling instead of being locked into a cramped viewport-height grid.

  2. ProfileEditor grids: All grid-cols-2 sections (personal info, experience, education, projects) now use grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 so fields stack vertically on mobile and only go two-column on larger screens.

  3. Label & tabs: The "Tell the AI about your history" label now scales down to text-base on mobile with relaxed leading-snug spacing, and the inner tab bar switches from 4 narrow columns to 2 wider ones on small screens.

The build passes cleanly and the form should be fully usable on narrow viewports now.

The build passes cleanly and the form should be fully usable on narrow viewports now.
